messages:
maria_cs: Hey team — quick sync on Marigold Health private deploy preflight. They've run the network/VPC steps but flagged gaps in KMS key policies and audit stream. Can we confirm what we need from them by EOD? 

devon_infra: thanks. I saw their infra ticket. Missing: cross-account KMS grant for our infra role, and VPC peering routes for the egress collector. Also they haven't shared the CloudTrail S3 bucket ARN. 

sam_networks: @devon_infra yep. Also the NACL on subnet 'mgd-app-1' blocks outbound 443 to our collector IP range. Asked them to open 443 to 10.0.200.0/24. 

kevin_security: On KMS: we require a customer-managed key with this policy snippet. They should add Principals for: arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/redwood-private-agent and allow Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey

kevin_security: Snippet:
```
{
  "Sid": "AllowRedwoodAgent",
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/redwood-private-agent"},
  "Action": ["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],
  "Resource": "*"
}
```

maria_cs: copying that to the ticket now. Also Marigold asked about audit retention — default is 90 days in our dashboard but they need 180. Is that supported in private? 

devon_infra: private deployments can ship audit logs to their S3. Retention is their responsibility; we can push to their bucket or ours depending on contract. For 180 days they'd configure lifecycle rules on their bucket — we can provide example lifecycle JSON. 

sam_networks: small ask: can we get a traceroute from their egress NAT to 10.0.200.10? They said they tested but didn't include hop list. That helps troubleshoot MTU/route issues. 

maria_cs: I'll ask them for traceroute + CloudTrail bucket ARN + confirm KMS policy change + NACL update. ETA from customer: by tomorrow noon PST. 

audits-bot: [audit-check] ticket #CS-4982 created and linked to infra ticket #INF-7241 — reminders set for 24h. 

kevin_security: Also flagging renewal risk: their contract renews in 45 days and onboarding delays may impact go-live. Let's capture an enablement plan in the renewal playbook so Sales has visibility. 

maria_cs: good call. I'll add a short summary to the renewal doc and ping @account-exec. 

devon_infra: if they can give us the CloudTrail ARN + traceroute we can run final preflight tests in ~2 hours. 

maria_cs: perfect — will update thread when I hear back. Thanks all :thumbsup:
